site.name: Leathrock
site.bio: In a world where everything seems ordinary and every space taken, I help intentional individuals uncover their extraordinary way of becoming.

about.heading: Faith, creativity, leadership and wisdom — never separated.
lines: Welcome to my corner of the world. My name is Oluwatimilehin Joshua Adedara. I'm the Visionary behind The Leathrock brand — a passionate advocate for personal, professional and spiritual growth, and a creative dedicated to helping others find their path(s) to purpose and achievement.

With a heart for Jesus and a love for empowering young people, I've founded not one, but two impactful initiatives: Fortes, a hub for general growth and development, and LeathCity, a thriving community centered around self-improvement, spiritual exploration, and business acumen.

Through my journey, I've devoured books on self-development, spirituality, business, and influence — and I'm excited to share my knowledge with you. My mission is to inspire and equip you to become the best version of yourself.
In this space, we'll explore the intersection of faith, creativity, leadership, and wisdom. Be active, engage with the content, and connect with like-minded individuals who share your passions.

branches.name: LeathCity
branches.intro: LeathCity is the paid community at the centre of the Leathrock world. Members are called Activators. Classes run live, correction is direct, and access is for life once your payment is complete.
mission: Our mission is to cultivate a community of influential entrepreneurs by fostering personal and professional development through spiritual, emotional, and intellectual growth.
We strive to empower aspiring influencers with tools and resources that help them build their personal brand, visibility, and impact so they can create positive change in their communities.
We are committed to equipping entrepreneurs with the knowledge, skills, and mindset needed to become self-aware, community-focused leaders with a lasting impact.

Our mission is to transform the entrepreneurial landscape by cultivating a community of self-aware, impactful, and influential leaders through comprehensive programs that focus on holistic personal and professional development.
Take community members on a journey of influence and leadership.

join.heading: How to join

steps.title: Start the lock
steps.text: A first payment of ₦5,000 or more fixes your access fee at today's rate.

steps.title: Rate secured
steps.text: Future increases don't apply to you. You keep the fee you locked.

steps.title: Pay at your pace
steps.text: Spread it across weeks or months. There's no deadline — but don't stall.

steps.title: Lifetime access
steps.text: Access opens once payment is complete, and it stays open.

join.note: The current access fee and per-Core pricing are confirmed directly before you pay.
join.wa: I'd like to join LeathCity. Please send me the current access fee and how to start my rate lock.

faqs: Can I pay in installments?
Yes.
Will I have access only after I've completed my payment?
Yes.
What is the least I can lock a rate with?
For now, ₦5,000 or more.
Do I have a time frame to complete my payment?
No — you can spread it across weeks and months. However, don't stall. You would be missing out on a lot.
Can I join the two Cores together?
No. You can only move from Illumination Core to Strategy Core.
Can I join the El-Activator Core alone?
No.
If the community gets temporarily locked while I'm paying in installments, can I continue?
Yes. If you've started paying in installments, you can continue during the lock-in.
If the access fee increases from the one I locked, am I on the new one?
No. You'd be working with the old access fee that you locked.
If I lock the rate with a part payment, am I starting all over?
No. Your remaining balance is simply the rest of the locked fee.
Is it lifetime access?
Yes.
Who should desire LeathCity?

If you own a brand and want to be better, or want to build one. If you're building something solid around your purpose. If you want to learn leadership for effectiveness sake. If you want to improve personally — communication, and the dispensation of what you have to offer. If you want spiritual growth. If you have a vision you need to strategically build on.

courses.title: TLNAC
courses.subtitle: The Lead Nurturing Audio Course
courses.short: The psychology of nurturing leads with integrity.
courses.summary: This isn't about tricks or tactics. It's about thinking clearly about your audience and delivering value at every stage.
learn: The psychology of effective lead nurturing
How to build trust through consistent, valuable communication
Systems for tracking and timing your outreach
How to qualify prospects without wasting their time
get: 4 audio lessons — more than 3 hours total
courses.forWho: Entrepreneurs, sales professionals, personal brands and business builders who want to nurture leads with integrity while maintaining systems that actually work.
curriculum: After lead generation, what's next? · Building an effective relationship with your leads · Common pain points to address in lead nurturing
Understanding why leads don't engage · How to quicken engagement · The transition from engagement to a reasonable buying action
Lead qualification and segmentation · Targeted content for different segments · Crafting content that resonates with your niche · Lead temperatures and how to nurture them
Timely and relevant follow-up · Lead seduction strategy · Improving communication and collaboration · Building a comprehensive lead nurturing strategy

courses.title: Women Leadership Training
courses.subtitle: Lead from authority, not apology
courses.short: Authority without mimicry, presence without apology.
courses.summary: Leadership presence isn't about gender. It's about clarity, conviction, and the discipline to lead with authenticity — not apology. This course examines the real obstacles women face when leading teams that include men, and how to overcome them through genuine leadership rather than mimicry or compensation.
learn: The psychological barriers women face in leadership positions
How to establish authority without compromising authenticity
Communication strategies that command respect without aggression
Building teams where gender doesn't determine capability
Managing the invisible pressure and imposter syndrome
Decision-making frameworks that cut through self-doubt
How to lead men — and anyone — by leading right, not differently
get: Real case studies of women leading effectively
courses.forWho: Women in management, founders, executives and emerging leaders who want to lead with clarity and confidence — not by fitting into someone else's mold.
